name: io.github.toolweather/toolweather
title: Toolweather
description: Is this MCP server healthy and safe to call now? Live checks of ~2,000 servers + alternatives.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Free API key (1,000 calls/day). Get one instantly: POST https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/keys or the get_api_key tool (no key needed).

_meta.io.github.toolweather/when_to_use: Before adding or calling a third-party MCP server, or after its calls fail: check_mcp_server_health. If unsafe or you need a capability: find_alternative_mcp_servers. Every result starts with a one-line summary, verdict, recommended_action, checked_at and freshness.
